name: Outdoor Chaise Lounge Chair Five-Position Adjustable Aluminum Recliner
material: powder coated Alu frame w/t 2*1 teslin fabric
description: The epitome of comfort and convenience, the Sunburst Chaise Lounge is stackable for effortless winter storage. This chaise lounge is crafted with a powder-coated aluminum frame and Batyline sling, providing durability and quick-drying functionality ideal for poolside use. The sling material remains cool and cleans easily from sunscreen lotions and food/drink spills. With integrated wheels, re-positioning this chaise on your patio is a breeze.
